title: 城市的孤独
text:
“你在这儿住多久了？”邻居轻声问我。
我看着窗外闪烁的霓虹灯，没有立刻回答。在这个巨大的都市里，人们每天匆忙走过。虽然周围到处是人，但内心却感到冷清。每个人都盯着手机，很少有人愿意抬头看对方。这种安静让人觉得陌生。
既然生活在这里，就得学会忍受寂寞。很多年轻人为了前途离开家乡。他们追求成功，却忘记了如何社交。工作压力很大，下班后只想一个人待在房间里。这种状态成了现代人的常态。
其实，真正的孤独不是身边没人。而是即便身在人群中，也找不到能沟通的人。我们习惯用网络代替真实的接触。虚拟的世界虽然热闹，但缺乏温度。
既然意识到了问题，就应该尝试改变。我们可以去公园散步，或者在书店读一本好书。偶尔与陌生人聊聊天，或许能发现生活的美好。在这个快速时代，慢下来才能感受到温暖。我们需要重新建立人与人之间的信任。只有这样，心里的空洞才能被填满。

questions.prompt: What does the neighbor ask the narrator at the start of the text?
According to the text, what do most people do instead of looking up at each other?
How does the author define true loneliness in the text?
options: Being unable to find someone to communicate with, even in a crowd

questions.prompt: What does the author suggest doing to counter loneliness?
options: Walk in the park or read in a bookstore

questions.prompt: What do people use as a substitute for real human contact, according to the text?

matches.span_text: 是即便身在人群中，也找不到能沟通的

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
